line: Crowley on Atu XI: the letter Teth, the sign Leo, the influence from Chesed upon Geburah, and the act of the original marriage (pdf p83, p84, p85).

sections.title: Sign and letter
sections.line: Crowley assigns the Trump to the sign of Leo and attributes the card to the letter Teth, a serpent (pdf p84).

quotes.quote: This Trump is assigned to the sign of Leo in the Zodiac.
This card is attributed to the letter Teth, which means a serpent.

sections.title: From Chesed upon Geburah
sections.line: Crowley on the path corresponding to the card as the influence from Chesed upon Geburah (pdf p83) and on the paths of Gimel and Teth (pdf p85).
